name: r1-lib-cublaslt-fp16-v3
author: solx-loop
description: Lineage A / E1 (H15, H16). A phase-separated library pipeline needs no tcgen05 code: custom depthwise conv, cuBLASLt fp16 GEMMs, custom GELU/GRN. LayerNorm is folded away (W1' = W1*lnw, with u[k] and cst[k] computed on the side) so the conv needs no per-token all-channel tile. 5 launches (6 on small images) should land S rows at 25-35 us. Result: 16/16 pass, run_tests projects 0.594 (anchor 0.304), but S rows are 35-55 us and 7x7 rows 57-89 us. cuBLASLt and the fp16 hidden round trip are cheap;
